$comment: Pre-existing consumer-domain addresses and non-reserved phone numbers, recorded so scripts/ci/check-fixture-pii.mjs fails only on NEW ones. Entries here are believed to be invented but have not all been audited. Adding an entry is a review decision: it asserts the value is not a real person's. Never add one to silence a genuine finding — replace the value with example.com / +1 555 01xx instead.
